snippet.title: The Aurora Chronicles | Sci-Fi Mystery Visual Novel | Episode 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Not all discoveries are meant to be found.

🎮 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4262410/The_Aurora_Chronicles/

The Aurora Chronicles is an episodic sci-fi visual novel with full voice acting, blending Star Trek optimism with X-Files mystery. Four crew members. Frontier mysteries. Truths that change everything.

Your choices shape your crew—and how humanity answers the biggest questions.

▶️ Demo available Steam Next Fest, February 2026

🎵 Soundtrack: https://aurorachronicles.bandcamp.com/album/the-aurora-chronicles-demo-soundtrack

𝕏 Follow for updates: https://x.com/entropy_42_

Early Access 2026 | Developed by Entropy
